title: French-inspired Kare Kare-Style Tofu
description: A fusion dish that combines the rich flavors of traditional Kare Kare with French culinary techniques. This silky, roasted tofu dish is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Wrap the tofu in foil and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the tofu is roasting, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Pour in the kare kare peanut sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until thickened.
Remove the tofu from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the tofu into thick medallions and serve with the kare kare sauce.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
